scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4)
other_conditions: Tool/equipment must be purchased from an authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer as notified by the Department of Agriculture.
Companies empanelled for tarpaulin seats must follow the Department of Agriculture regulations.
Companies empanelled for plastic crates must follow the Department of Agriculture regulations.
benefits_summary: SC farmers receive assistance up to 75% of tool/equipment cost or ₹3,750, whichever is lower; farmer groups/co‑operative societies receive up to 90% of equipment cost or ₹7,50,000, whichever is lower, for PHM equipment.
